card.name: Small words before 'scheduled time' or 'day'
card.fires_on: Small determiner-like words such as 'its', 'other', 'entire', 'each', 'any' placed before a noun. Most often in missed-dose instructions ('take the next dose at its scheduled time') and 'every other day'.

modes.label: Missed-dose wording
modes.description: The word 'its' just before 'scheduled/usual time' in instructions on the next dose.
modes.example: instruct the patient to skip the dose and take the next dose at<< its>> usual scheduled time.

modes.label: Quantifier or modifier words
modes.description: Words like 'other', 'entire', 'each', 'whole', 'any' before a noun in general text.
modes.example: once every<< other>> day Treatment of gout flares with
